blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanisation (SMAM) was launched to increase farm power availability and foster inclusive growth among small and marginal farmers.
Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs) and Farm Machinery Banks (FMBs) mitigate the high capital cost barrier of modern farm implements through rental services.
Effective farm mechanisation enhances input-use efficiency, ensures timeliness of operations, and significantly reduces human drudgery.
Watershed management integrates land and water conservation treatments following a systematic 'Ridge to Valley' approach.

blocks.content: Agricultural mechanisation plays a crucial role in increasing agricultural production and productivity by ensuring timeliness of operations and efficient use of inputs.

items: Launched in 2014 to promote farm mechanisation at the grassroots level
Provides subsidy (40–80%) on purchase of farm machinery to farmers
Custom Hiring Centres (CHC) set up to provide machinery on rental basis
Farm Machinery Banks for small/marginal farmers; Village Level entrepreneurs promoted
High-tech hubs for demonstration and training of farm machinery
SMAM subsidy rates: 50% financial assistance is extended to Small & Marginal farmers, SC/ST, Women, and North-Eastern state beneficiaries, while 40% applies to other categories.
Establishment of Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs) attracts up to 40% financial assistance under SMAM guidelines.
Differentiate frequently tested implements: Mouldboard and Disc Ploughs are Primary Tillage tools, whereas Cultivators and Rotavators are Secondary Tillage tools.

blocks.content: Watershed is a land area that drains to a common point. Watershed management integrates soil, water, and vegetation for sustainable development of a geographical unit.

items: National Watershed Development Project for Rainfed Areas (NWDPRA) — now under PMKSY
IWMP (Integrated Watershed Management Programme) — now merged into PMKSY-Watershed
Techniques: Check dams, gully plugs, nala bunding, field bunding, vegetative barriers
Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchai Yojana — Watershed Component focuses on 2nd generation watershed projects
